$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema path for editor validation.

maxTurns.description: Maximum review rounds before the orchestrator gives up.

maxRetries.description: Retry attempts for transient failures (429, 503, timeouts).

heartbeatMs.description: How often to emit a 'still working' ping. 0 = disabled.

maxRetryAfterMs.description: Cap on the Retry-After sleep derived from upstream error messages.

maxLineBytes.description: Max bytes for a single JSON-RPC line from a sub-agent (OOM guard).

maxOutputBytes.description: Max total accumulated streamed or direct final text output per sub-agent (OOM guard).

reviewerAgentChars.description: Max characters of each sub-agent result included in the reviewer prompt.

concurrency.description: Max sub-agents running simultaneously per group (fairness semaphore).

probeTimeoutMs.description: Health-probe timeout per agent on round 1. Agents that fail are skipped. 0 disables probes.

envIsolation.description: When true, sub-agents only inherit SAFE_ENV_KEYS plus explicit passEnv.

defaultGroup.description: Initial agent group for each new Zed session.

items.description: Name of an agent group to run after the previous group is approved.

rateLimits.description: Token-bucket rate limits keyed by command or rateLimitKey.

requestsPerMinute.description: Average token-bucket refill rate for this key, measured in requests per minute.

burstSize.description: Maximum burst capacity for this key. Defaults to requestsPerMinute when omitted.

mcpServers.description: MCP tool servers shared across all sub-agents.

type.description: MCP transport type: http for URL servers, stdio for child-process servers.

name.description: MCP server name forwarded to child agents.

url.description: HTTP MCP endpoint URL. Required when type is http.

command.description: Executable for a stdio MCP server. Required when type is stdio.

items.description: One command-line argument for the stdio MCP server.

args.description: Arguments passed to a stdio MCP server command.

env.description: Stdio MCP environment entries. Values support {env:ENV_VAR} and ${ENV_VAR} expansion.

name.description: Environment variable name passed to the stdio MCP server.

headers.description: HTTP headers forwarded to this MCP server. Values support {env:ENV_VAR} and ${ENV_VAR} expansion.

name.description: HTTP header name sent to the MCP server.

items.description: Agent spec for the legacy default group.

reviewer.description: Legacy default reviewer, or fallback for groups that omit their own.

additionalProperties.description: Agent group keyed by the group name used in defaultGroup, workflow, and @orchestrator group directives.

description.description: Human-readable group purpose for operators reading the config.

persist.description: When false, the session resets to defaultGroup after this prompt. Defaults false for single_writer groups.

strategy.description: parallel_reports runs read-only agents and synthesizes reports; single_writer allows one named writer.

permissions.description: Default ACP proxy policy for sub-agents in this group.

reviewerPermissions.description: ACP proxy policy for the reviewer. Must remain read-only.

writerPermissions.description: ACP proxy policy for the named writer in single_writer groups.

writer.description: Name of the single sub-agent allowed to mutate code in a single_writer group.

attachApprovedPlanFrom.description: Group name whose approved-plan.md should be auto-attached before this group runs.

artifactDir.description: Workspace-relative artifact directory override for this group.

maxTurns.description: Review-round limit override for this group.

concurrency.description: Override global concurrency for this group.

subAgents.description: Agents run for this group before the reviewer synthesizes results.

reviewer.description: Agent that reviews and synthesizes sub-agent outputs for this group.

mcp.description: Forward MCP servers to agents when child capabilities allow them.

allowUnknownClientRequests.description: Writer-only escape hatch: when true, unknown (non-fs/terminal/permission) child client methods are forwarded to Zed.

writeFiles.description: Must stay false for read-only groups and reviewers.

terminal.description: Must stay false for read-only groups and reviewers.

mcp.description: Forward MCP servers only when every forwarded server is known read-only.

allowUnknownClientRequests.description: Must stay false for read-only groups and reviewers.

workspaceRelativePath.description: Workspace-relative path without absolute roots, empty segments, or .. traversal.

name.description: Display name used in Zed output and writer matching.

command.description: Executable used to start this ACP agent. Values support {env:ENV_VAR}, ${ENV_VAR}, and whole-string $ENV_VAR expansion.

sandboxCommand.description: Optional wrapper executable used to sandbox this child process. The real command and args are appended after sandboxArgs.

sandboxArgs.description: Arguments passed to sandboxCommand before the real agent command and args.

rateLimitKey.description: Name of the rateLimits bucket used by this agent. Defaults to command when omitted.

passEnv.description: Environment variable names forwarded from the orchestrator process when envIsolation is true.

credHome.description: Workspace-relative, absolute, or ~/... dir used as HOME for this agent. Isolates credential files.

allowRealHome.description: When envIsolation is true and credHome is unset, explicitly allow forwarding the real HOME/XDG directories.

agentTimeoutMs.description: Per-agent wall-clock timeout override in milliseconds.

maxRetries.description: Per-agent retry-attempt override for transient failures.

retryDelayMs.description: Per-agent base retry backoff override in milliseconds.

heartbeatMs.description: Per-agent still-working ping interval override in milliseconds. 0 disables pings.
